interface.shortDescription: Prepare source-bound P&L, working-capital, and customer-concentration evidence.
interface.longDescription: Vera workflow for preparing financial-analysis evidence under explicit dataset, relationship, crosswalk, reconciliation, and reproducibility contracts. It recognizes three deterministic packs: monthly P&L, working capital, and customer concentration. Prepared evidence remains distinct from professional conclusions and report-ready claims.
defaultPrompt: Use Vera Financial Analysis on the accounting files I provide.
Choose the relevant monthly P&L, working-capital, or customer-concentration pack, establish the source and relationship contracts, and validate the prepared evidence.
Keep accounting judgments explicit and do not present prepared evidence as a professional conclusion.
